description: On Friday at the Capitol, I was honored to receive the Ireland Seal of Office, from Senator Mark Daly, President of the Ireland Senate. It commemorates the work we are doing to increase opportunities for business, tourism, education, healthcare, and cultural exchange between Colorado and Ireland

title: A Big Week Two at the Capitol — Anthony Hartsook
